stories.headline: FCC Blocks New Robot and Power Inverter Imports Over Security Risks
stories.body: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has blocked the importation, marketing or sale of new foreign-produced mobile robots and connected power inverters. stories.headline: Visa says AI is helping to enable workforce cuts
stories.body: The card network is cutting 7% of its staff, with management saying artificial intelligence-driven efficiency and faster technology development is part of the reason.
